# compute new time: 21:30 +20 minutes
old_time='21:30'
h,m=map(int,old_time.split(':'))
total=h*60+m+20
new_h=(total//60)%24
new_m=total%60
new_time=f"{new_h:02d}:{new_m:02d}"
print('new_time',new_time)

# target alarm id 409 label Go to sleep; disable others
alarms_info=[
 {'alarm_id':407,'label':'Wake Up'},
 {'alarm_id':408,'label':'Wake Up'},
 {'alarm_id':410,'label':'Weekly Work Standup Meeting'},
 {'alarm_id':412,'label':'Clean the House'},
 {'alarm_id':413,'label':'Pick up Laundry'},
 {'alarm_id':411,'label':'Water Plants'},
 {'alarm_id':409,'label':'Go to sleep'}
]
print('all alarm ids', [a['alarm_id'] for a in alarms_info])
print('sleep alarm', [a for a in alarms_info if 'Go to sleep' in a['label']])

# update sleep alarm
resp_sleep=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=409, access_token=token, time=new_time, enabled=True)
print('update sleep resp',resp_sleep)

# disable rest
rest=[a['alarm_id'] for a in alarms_info if a['alarm_id']!=409]
results=[]
for aid in rest:
    r=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=aid, access_token=token, enabled=False)
    results.append((aid,r))
    print('disabled',aid,'resp',r)

print('done')
